outcome: Complications during pregnancy (preeclampsia and placenta praevia)
cohort: The study included 66 RYR1-variant carrying females and 88 non-mutated controls, comprising unaffected relatives and the general healthy population.
finding: Women carrying RYR1 variants exhibited a higher incidence of pathological bleeding scores, severe menstrual bleeding, complications during pregnancy (preeclampsia and placenta praevia), frequent planned Caesarean sections, offspring with lower birthweight, and gastrointestinal symptoms compared to controls.
mod_finding: Women with RYR1 variants showed a higher incidence of frequent planned Caesarean sections.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at the time of online questionnaire completion, retrospectively covering past obstetric and gynaecological events.
birth_weight: Lower birthweight in offspring of RYR1-variant carrying females
